title: Variable bound for a binary operation
statement: For any binary operation symbol $o$ and expressions $a,b$, the variable bound of the expression formed by applying $o$ to $a$ and $b$ is at most $F$ if and only if the variable bounds of both $a$ and $b$ are at most $F$.
